items.title: Apolipoprotein A1 Infusions and Cardiovascular Outcomes after Acute Myocardial Infarction.
items.journal: The New England journal of medicine
items.summary: CSL112 (apolipoprotein A1 infusions) failed to reduce cardiovascular events after acute myocardial infarction in a large randomized controlled trial.

items.title: Ticagrelor in Patients with Stable Coronary Disease and Diabetes.
items.journal: The New England journal of medicine
items.summary: Ticagrelor plus aspirin showed no significant benefit over placebo plus aspirin in patients with stable coronary artery disease and diabetes without prior MI or stroke.

items.title: Angina in stable coronary artery disease: Data from ORBITA and ORBITA-2.
items.journal: Cardiovascular revascularization medicine : including molecular interventions
items.summary: ORBITA and ORBITA-2 trials demonstrated that percutaneous coronary intervention provided no significant improvement in angina compared to placebo procedure in stable coronary artery disease.

items.title: Colchicine may become a new cornerstone therapy for coronary artery disease: a meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: Meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials evaluating colchicine efficacy and safety in coronary artery disease patients.

items.title: Percutaneous coronary intervention or coronary artery bypass graft in left main coronary artery disease: a comprehensive meta-analysis of adjusted observational studies and randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: Comprehensive meta-analysis comparing percutaneous coronary intervention versus coronary artery bypass graft in left main coronary artery disease.

items.title: Chronic Heart Failure and Coronary Artery Disease: Pharmacological Treatment and Cardiac Rehabilitation.
items.summary: Review of pharmacological treatment and cardiac rehabilitation approaches for patients with chronic heart failure and coronary artery disease.

items.title: Endothelial Dysfunction, Inflammation and Coronary Artery Disease: Potential Biomarkers and Promising Therapeutical Approaches.
items.summary: Review of endothelial dysfunction, inflammation and coronary artery disease focusing on potential biomarkers and therapeutic approaches.

items.title: Stable coronary artery disease - medical treatment.
items.journal: Polski merkuriusz lekarski : organ Polskiego Towarzystwa Lekarskiego
items.summary: Overview of medical treatment options for stable coronary artery disease including secondary prevention and antianginal therapies.

items.title: Genetics of coronary artery disease: discovery, biology and clinical translation.
items.summary: Comprehensive review of the genetics of coronary artery disease covering discovery, biology and clinical translation.

items.title: Empagliflozin and left atrial function in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus and coronary artery disease: insight from the EMPA-HEART CardioLink-6 randomized clinical trial.
Effects of Vitamin K2 and D Supplementation on Coronary Artery Disease in Men: A RCT.
The MOVEMENT Trial.
items.journal: Journal of the American Heart Association

canonicalFacts.claim: Coronary artery disease is the leading global cause of mortality
Inflammatory activation and endothelial dysfunction are key events in atherosclerosis development
Approximately 60 genetic loci have been linked to coronary risk through common variant association studies
Percutaneous coronary intervention in stable angina primarily aims for symptom relief rather than mortality benefit

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Secondary prevention measures including effective control of risk factors and concomitant diseases

redFlags: Morphine administration can delay onset of action of orally administered ticagrelor in STEMI patients
Patients with premature coronary artery disease have increasing mortality trends, particularly in rural women
